description.narrative: The project’s primary goal is to support grassroots community organisations (CBOs) and self-help groups (SHGs) within communities affected by climate vulnerability and the livelihood insecurity in Les Cayes (Drought) and Camp-Perrin (Flood) communes in South and IDP survivors fleeing gangs’ violence in the Port-au-Prince Metropolitan area. The project objective is to utilize the SCLR approach to adopt more sustainable practices and mitigate the impacts of natural disaster and anthropogenic activities on their environment and livelihoods in Les Cayes and Camp-Perrin in the South department of Haiti. This initiative aims to address immediate needs and enhance community preparedness and resilience against future disasters. The project aims to directly assist at least 125 vulnerable households, comprising approximately 625 individuals, by providing direct funding to CBOs/Self-Help Groups for the implementation of their priority initiatives within their respective communities. These households will be identified among the IDPs and vulnerable communities dependent of agriculture, livestock and employment opportunities. Identified vulnerable and marginalized groups include people living with disabilities, single mothers, IDPs, older individuals lacking family support, and families living below the poverty line.
